thread:
lee: Idea for next Friday  Shoutout Sundae: invite an ice cream truck to the SF office courtyard, hand out small printed 'kudos cards' + $10 treat vouchers as spot-awards for peer-nominated wins. low effort, high delight. thoughts?

tia: love. quick Q re: vouchers  are those treated like gift cards for payroll? also any dietary note we should capture (dairy-free/vegan)? :icecream:

people-ops: This sounds fun. Budget check  we have a $600 micro-event budget for HQ activations. Need vendor quote, plan for tracking recipients, and an event owner for receipts. We'll confirm tax treatment with payroll.

lee: vendor I checked  ScoopsOnWheels quoted $420 for 2 hours (truck + 1 server). Voucher printing from QuickPrint is ~$35. Total ~ $455.

people-ops-bot: /reminder set "Confirm ScoopsOnWheels quote" for @lee tomorrow 09:00

kevin: I can build a tiny Google form for nominations + dietary flags and a sheet to tally vouchers. happy to own that if people-ops is ok.

harpreet: i'll volunteer to hand out vouchers 12:00-12:45 and bring some vegan toppings (brought my own last meetup lol).

ben: also can cover 12:45-1:30. i'll take photos for the org channel. :camera_with_flash:

finance: FYI from payroll side: small vouchers under $50 per person typically get treated as de minimis and may not be run through payroll, but we need to track recipients and value. Anything cash-equivalent or >$100 will need reporting. We'll confirm for this program.

tia: perfect. can we include a short transparency blurb on the RSVP? something like: "Vouchers are tracked and may be reported per company policy."

people-ops: Yes. We'll add that language. Also plan: we should capture recipient email on the voucher log and save receipts to #expenses.

lee: logistics checklist (draft):
```
- book ScoopsOnWheels (confirm power + spot)
- print 150 vouchers (QR to nomination form)
- set up 2 volunteer shifts (12:00-12:45, 12:45-1:30)
- bring spare markers, clipboards, card tray
- post invite + dietary note
- submit expense report after event
```

kevin: I'll post the RSVP form link in the invite and include a dietary checkbox. also will add a checkbox for "I nominate someone" so folks can pre-nominate.

people-ops-bot: shoutouts-bot: Tip: use `/spot-award @colleague <reason>` at the truck or via the form to auto-log awards.

harpreet: small note  do we want to do voucher amounts $5 or $10? $10 feels nicer but adds up. 150 people x $10 = $1500 so maybe only print 60 vouchers.

people-ops: Let's print 75 vouchers at $10 = $750 + truck $420 = $1,170 which exceeds micro-event cap. Alternative: 100 vouchers at $5 = $500 + $420 = $920. We can ask for exception but prefer to stay under $800. Options: negotiate truck to $350, or go with $5 vouchers.

lee: I'll try to negotiate to $350. If not, we pivot to $5 vouchers and 100 qty.

finance: If we need to go above the cap for culture events, loop in your manager + finance for approval. Provide itemized estimate and headcount impact.

ben: idea  do a mix: 50 x $10 surprise spot-awards for live nominations + general free scoop via company credit for everyone else (covered by truck flat fee). then fewer vouchers printed.

people-ops: That mix sounds reasonable. Final plan:
- lee to negotiate price and confirm power/location with Facilities.
- kevin to build form and pre-nominate option, include dietary.
- harpreet/ben sign up for shifts.
- people-ops to draft 2-sentence tax blurb once payroll confirms.
- finance to advise if we need approval for >$800.

lee: will update here by EOD tomorrow with vendor status. If we get sub-$800 quote, I'll submit invoice to #expenses.

people-ops: Sweet. If approved we'll aim for Friday 12:00-1:30. Thanks team! :sparkles:
